claim_boundary: One local single-entity USD profile:1000 native three-human cash/equity postings, four workers, same seed and warmed verified reads. Latency includes authentication. Not HTTP TPS, mixed ERP capacity, production sizing, causal proof, SLO, failover or competitor comparison.

limits: native repository latency includes synthetic identity authentication
no cost per transaction without a supplied resource cost model
measurement.telemetry_policy: read-only 10-second sampled resources on owned synthetic fixture; no production DSN or row content
measurement.postgres_io_timing_interpretation: blk_read_time_ms/blk_write_time_ms are cumulative pg_stat_database counters; zero milliseconds with track_io_timing=off do not prove zero I/O latency; no I/O peak is measured

verified_reads.measurement_scope: authenticated native verified effect reads; no HTTP or database-internal query count
authenticated native verified effect reads; no HTTP or database-internal query count

resource_sampling.scope: sampled peaks can miss shorter spikes; client lifetime RSS differs from Python allocation peak

resource_summary.scope: Observed maxima of10-second samples, not resource peaks. First-to-last counters exclude initial seeding and include reads/sampler queries; Docker displays rounded values.
resource_summary.io_timing_interpretation: Zero timings with track_io_timing=off do not prove zero I/O latency.

comparison_scope: One observation per source on same reported hardware/profile. Docker was restarted before the post-repair run; host contention/cache state and sampling differ. Ratios are observations, not isolated causality or confidence intervals.
